question: A mathematics group studies three movable directed segments represented by $\vec{a}=3\hat{i}-2\hat{j}+\hat{k}$, $\vec{b}=-3\hat{i}+2\hat{j}-\hat{k}$ and $\vec{c}=3\hat{i}-2\hat{j}+\hat{k}$. The segments may be shifted parallel to themselves without changing their magnitude or direction. The group compares corresponding components, magnitudes and directions to decide whether the vectors are equal, negatives of one another or produce a zero vector when combined.(a) Calculate the magnitudes of $\vec{a}$ and $\vec{c}$.(b) Determine whether $\vec{a}$ and $\vec{c}$ are equal vectors and justify the conclusion.(c) Evaluate $\vec{a}+\vec{b}$ and identify the resulting vector.(d) Establish the relationship between $\vec{a}$ and $\vec{b}$ by comparing their magnitudes and directions.
explanation: (a)`|\vec{a}|=\sqrt{3^2+(-2)^2+1^2}=\sqrt{14}`Similarly,`|\vec{c}|=\sqrt{3^2+(-2)^2+1^2}=\sqrt{14}`Thus, $|\vec{a}|=|\vec{c}|=\sqrt{14}$.(b)The corresponding components of $\vec{a}$ and $\vec{c}$ are identical:`\vec{a}=3\hat{i}-2\hat{j}+\hat{k}=\vec{c}`Therefore, they have the same magnitude and direction and are equal vectors.(c)`\vec{a}+\vec{b}=(3-3)\hat{i}+(-2+2)\hat{j}+(1-1)\hat{k}\vec{a}+\vec{b}=0\hat{i}+0\hat{j}+0\hat{k}=\vec{0}`The resulting vector is the zero vector.(d)The vectors have equal magnitudes because`|\vec{a}|=|\vec{b}|=\sqrt{14}`Every component of $\vec{b}$ is the negative of the corresponding component of $\vec{a}$. Hence, their directions are opposite and`\vec{b}=-\vec{a}`Therefore, $\vec{b}$ is the negative of $\vec{a}$.

options.A:
(a) $|\vec{a}|=|\vec{c}|=\sqrt{12}$
(b) $\vec{a}\ne\vec{c}$
(c) $\vec{a}+\vec{b}=\hat{i}$
(d) $\vec{a}$ and $\vec{b}$ have equal magnitudes and the same direction
options.D:
(a) $|\vec{a}|=|\vec{c}|=\sqrt{14}$
(b) $\vec{a}=\vec{c}$
(c) $\vec{a}+\vec{b}=\vec{0}$
(d) $\vec{b}=-\vec{a}$; they have equal magnitudes and opposite directions
